description.text: The last Black & White set, released on 6 November 2013 with 140 cards: 113, gold Reshiram and Zekrom, and the 25-card Radiant Collection, numbered RC with a special coating and foil. Much of it reprints popular cards of the series, many with new art: ten Pokémon-EX return, among them Mewtwo-EX, Darkrai-EX and Keldeo-EX, beside two new ones, Chandelure-EX and Excadrill-EX, evolved Pokémon as Pokémon-EX.

description.text: The 1st Place League Challenge copy of Deino: a crosshatch holofoil print stamped with the Pokémon League logo and its placing, the prize for first place. League Challenges were small tournaments that a store running a Pokémon League could hold once a month; each came with a sealed kit of twelve of these cards, three for each place, for the top four players in each age division. The crosshatch pattern marks the early League Challenge promos, from the first events in 2013 until BREAKthrough in 2015.
